headline: Iran's national security chief Mohsen Rezaei says Tehran is debating whether to maintain its ban on nuclear weapons if'
dek: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- statement fact only] Rezaei told state TV Iran is debating whether to maintain its longstanding ban on nuclear weapons if hostilities resume, although no decision on any change has been taken (Reuters via Dawn). This is a statement about an internal debate, NOT a policy…
sources: Mohsen Rezaei, Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, on Iranian state TV, as reported by Reuters and relayed by Dawn liveblog
fault_line: Deterrence by building a bomb vs the cost and escalation risk of abandoning the ban.
